canonical_project: XDS Data Centres 1MW immersion-cooled data center at SRTI Park
notes: DCD reported (Aug 2025) XDS inaugurated a 1MW immersion-cooled colocation facility at Sharjah Research Technology and Innovation Park (SRTI Park), the UAE's first live immersion-cooled AI data hall; validation for larger multi-MW deployments. Mapped to Sharjah - Sharjah (SRTI Park/University City).
